title: All-h deterministic nine-cell source-conditioned Fréchet transportation relaxation
statement: For every s=2^h>=2, every complete separately globally injected original point-map f and original line-map g, and each of the nine eligible genuine original source forest cells F, let U_F be the actual source-only six-incidence-ID universe, N_F=|U_F|, L_F(f)=U_F∩H_P(f) and R_F(g)=U_F∩H_L(g). The ACTUAL shared original-ID intersection X_F=|L_F(f)∩R_F(g)| satisfies X_F>=max(0, |L_F(f)|+|R_F(g)|-N_F). Summing these nonnegative floors over the eight NON-AA source forest cells yields a deterministic lower for the actual non-AA accepted positive GF5 count. The sum of floors is the exact optimum of a RELAXATION allowing arbitrary independent subsets in each U_F, NOT an assertion that a corresponding global pair of injections f,g exists. The AA cell requires the common aligned connected original-column D6 positional tensor and receives NO unconditional positive D6 certificate from this coarse source-cell marginal formula alone.

quantifiers.domain: integer h>=1, s=2^h, genuine original W(3,s)
any complete separately typed globally injected ORIGINAL point and line maps shared across all true source six-ID sets

external_dependencies: Elementary inclusion-exclusion for subsets of the SAME finite source-only U_F: |L∩R|>=|L|+|R|-|U_F|.
A/A accepted D6 requires identical positional six-column physical connected C6 dual H, separately registered in AA4-T.
limitations: A zero relaxed non-AA floor does not entail an actual zero non-AA joint intersection for complete original f,g.
Sharpness is only in the ABSTRACT arbitrary-subset model; global physical pair-label injections can impose higher-order correlations.
The A/A source forest sector is NOT fully accepted merely because the two one-sided physical A constraints hold; connected aligned D6 remains mandatory.
falsification_boundary: Both source subsets use exactly identical six ACTUAL original incidence IDs, and each one-sided physical mapping is a single coherent global injection across all Q. Do not promote relaxed extremizers to physical counterlabels.
